{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Screening visit overloaded with procedures",
      "quote": "Tumor tissue sample",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The Screening Visit X includes many procedures (informed consent, medical history, ECG, performance status, tumor tissue sample, randomization, etc.) all on one day, which may be burdensome for patients and sites.",
      "fix": "Consider splitting the screening procedures across multiple visits or allowing a screening window."
    },
    {
      "title": "Tumor tissue sample collection at screening may be difficult",
      "quote": "Tumor tissue sample",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Collecting a tumor tissue sample at screening may require a biopsy procedure that is invasive and may not be feasible for all patients, especially if archival tissue is not available.",
      "fix": "Clarify if archival tissue is acceptable or allow a window for tissue collection."
    },
    {
      "title": "Vital signs not collected at Day 8 and Day 15 despite treatment",
      "quote": "Vital signs",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Vital signs are only collected at Screening, Day 1, and Day 22, but patients receive irinotecan on Day 8 and Day 15, and gemcitabine/vinorelbine on Day 8. Lack of vital signs on treatment days may miss acute reactions.",
      "fix": "Add vital signs collection on Day 8 and Day 15, or justify their omission."
    },
    {
      "title": "Limited physical examination not performed on Day 8 and Day 15",
      "quote": "Limited physical examination",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Limited physical examination is only at Day 1 and Day 22, but patients receive treatment on Day 8 and Day 15. Physical exams on those days would be expected for safety monitoring.",
      "fix": "Add limited physical examination on Day 8 and Day 15, or provide rationale for omission."
    },
    {
      "title": "CT/MRI only at screening and Day 42, but response assessments are more frequent",
      "quote": "CT scan and/or MRI",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The SoA shows CT/MRI only at screening and Day 42, but Section 7.2.2 states tumor response assessments are performed at end of cycles 1-4, 6, 8, etc. This is a major discrepancy.",
      "fix": "Align the SoA with the response assessment schedule described in Section 7.2.2."
    },
    {
      "title": "Cemiplimab and pemetrexed only on Day 1 and Day 22, but cycle length unclear",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab (experimental)",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "Cemiplimab and pemetrexed are only given on Day 1 and Day 22, but the cycle length is not specified. If cycles are 21 days, Day 22 would be the next cycle; if 28 days, Day 29 would be expected. This is confusing.",
      "fix": "Clarify the cycle length and align the dosing schedule accordingly."
    },
    {
      "title": "Height and weight only at screening and Day 1, but weight changes may affect dosing",
      "quote": "Weight and height (height at screening only)",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "burden",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "Weight is only measured at screening and Day 1, but many chemotherapies are dosed by body surface area (BSA) which requires weight updates. Not measuring weight at later visits may lead to inaccurate dosing.",
      "fix": "Add weight measurement at each treatment visit or at least at each cycle start."
    },
    {
      "title": "ECG only at screening, but cardiac monitoring may be needed during treatment",
      "quote": "Electrocardiogram",
      "page": 53,
      "section": "7.1 Schedule of Activities",
      "category": "advisory",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "ECG is only performed at screening. Given that patients receive multiple chemotherapies, some with cardiotoxic potential, periodic ECGs during treatment may be prudent.",
      "fix": "Consider adding ECGs at specified intervals during treatment, especially if any drug has known cardiac effects."
    }
  ]
}
